nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the name of the family piggy bank; written in the constructor.
Public mapping(address => uint) state variable that stores the credited balance of each saver.
Public uint state variable initialised with address(this).balance at deployment.
Payable constructor: sets spardosenName, reads msg.value into startGuthaben and credits the initial balance to _sparer or msg.sender.
Payable deposit function that blindly assigns msg.value as the whole balance of msg.sender, overwriting any previous credit.
Withdraw function: checks the caller's balance, subtracts _betrag (unchecked arithmetic in 0.4.24) and transfers Ether to msg.sender.
View getter returning the stored balance of a given address.
Pure helper function returning the unchecked sum of two unsigned integers.
Caller-controlled address used as mapping key in constructor, einzahlen and abbuchen and as transfer recipient in abbuchen.
msg.sender.transfer(_betrag): external Ether transfer to an untrusted caller address.
guthaben[msg.sender] = guthaben[msg.sender] - _betrag: unchecked unsigned subtraction (overflow/underflow possible, no SafeMath).
_menge1 + _menge2: unchecked unsigned addition (overflow possible, no SafeMath).
Constructor parameter _name, the piggy bank name supplied by the deployer.
Constructor parameter _sparer, optional beneficiary address supplied by the deployer.
Local variable startGuthaben initialised from msg.value inside the constructor.
Parameter _betrag of abbuchen, the amount of Ether the caller wants to withdraw.
Parameter _sparer of guthabenAnzeigen, the address whose balance is queried.
First operand _menge1 of the pure addieren function.
Second operand _menge2 of the pure addieren function.

edges.reason: The constructor writes the supplied name into the spardosenName state variable.
The _name parameter flows into the constructor and is stored in state.
The _sparer parameter flows into the constructor and selects the credited address.
The local startGuthaben, initialised from msg.value, determines the initial credit in the constructor.
The constructor writes startGuthaben into the guthaben mapping for _sparer or msg.sender.
msg.sender is used as the default beneficiary key inside the constructor.
einzahlen overwrites guthaben[msg.sender] with the transaction value.
msg.sender is the key whose balance is overwritten in einzahlen.
abbuchen reads and writes guthaben[msg.sender] when checking and decrementing the balance.
msg.sender is both the balance owner and the recipient inside abbuchen.
The withdraw amount _betrag controls the subtraction and the transfer inside abbuchen.
abbuchen performs an unchecked subtraction on the caller balance, allowing integer underflow/overflow.
abbuchen sends Ether to msg.sender after updating state, enabling reentrancy on the transfer call.
The Ether transfer is directed to the untrusted caller address, which may execute a fallback and re-enter.
guthabenAnzeigen reads the guthaben mapping to return the queried balance.
The queried address _sparer is used as the mapping lookup key in guthabenAnzeigen.
addieren computes an unchecked unsigned addition of its two operands.
_menge1 is a direct operand of the addition performed in addieren.
_menge2 is a direct operand of the addition performed in addieren.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _name has no standalone security meaning; it is only consumed by the constructor, so collapse it into the constructor node.
Parameter _sparer only selects the beneficiary inside the constructor and should be merged into the constructor node.
Local variable startGuthaben is a temporary view of msg.value used only inside the constructor and can be merged into it.
Parameter _betrag is only meaningful as the withdraw amount driving the arithmetic and transfer in abbuchen, so merge it into abbuchen.
Parameter _sparer of guthabenAnzeigen is only a lookup key for the getter and should be merged into guthabenAnzeigen.
Parameter _menge1 is a pure operand of addieren with no separate identity; merge it into addieren.
Parameter _menge2 is a pure operand of addieren with no separate identity; merge it into addieren.
